title: SecureCAI: Injection-Resilient LLM Assistants for Cybersecurity Operations
reasoning: The paper focuses on defensive frameworks against prompt injection in cybersecurity settings. While it uses 'Constitutional AI' principles to guide model behavior towards 'harmlessness,' these principles are technical security guardrails (such as preventing data exfiltration or malware generation) rather than an evaluation or benchmarking of religious, spiritual, or philosophical ethics.
